slice: RPP-5kx selected combined angle-and-offset MLINE retarget projection
scope: Extends the existing source-bound AC1027 open, uncut, unfilled MLINE retarget projection to one profile where the target MLINESTYLE changes both start/end angles and element offsets. It reuses the existing endpoint miter and first group-41 parameter projection. The receipt proves one exact source/output profile only; other numeric combinations and native CAD semantics remain unqualified.

references.use: Groups 49, 51 and 52 encode element offsets and start/end angles; group 70 contains documented style flags. The reference does not prescribe the adapter's geometry projection.

Group 340 is the MLINESTYLE pointer; group 13 records vertex miter directions; group 41 records per-element segment parameters, whose first value is the miter-distance to the line-element path intersection. Group 2 is redundant and must not be changed independently.

contract.admission: AC1027 source and output. The selected source style is flags=2 with two elements, offsets [1.25,-0.75], and angles 90/90 degrees. The target changes offsets to [1.5,-1.25] and angles to 60/120 degrees while keeping flags and element count. Both source-bound MLINE consumers are retargeted to the target through group 340; their redundant group-2 names stay unchanged. The admitted MLINE profiles are open, uncut, unfilled, three-vertex, positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, with valid source directions, miters and parameter arrays.
contract.projection: The implementation recognizes a coupled projection when the target has known flags, equal flags and arity, and finite angles. It derives changed endpoint miter vectors from the target angles and recomputes each first group-41 distance using the target offset and target justification minimum. The source profile validates existing geometry and parameters against the original style before projecting. The selected bottom-justified consumer has a changed minimum offset, so its justification shift is exercised.
contract.identityAndOutput: Across ASCII/binary source and output combinations, the receipt checks target MLINESTYLE group 70, groups 49/51/52, output ownership and identity; MLINE group 340 points to the emitted target while group 2 remains original; each emitted group-13 miter and group-41 value matches independently calculated expected values. Fresh import verifies the two style bodies and both consumers' handles, unchanged redundant names, geometry, miter vectors, parameters and empty fill arrays.
contract.failureAndRetry: For both output encodings, changing the target flags from 2 to 0 refuses before publication and preserves destination/caller state; restoring flags permits same-adapter retry. For both output encodings, a late consumer parameter mutation after entity emission refuses without publication; restoring the caller snapshot permits same-adapter retry.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. The regression creates its source DXF at runtime and uses temporary outputs; no fixture file is committed. Existing angle-only and offset-only projections continue to pass their focused selectors.
contract.limits: Evidence covers only AC1027, flags 2, equal two-element arity, source offsets [1.25,-0.75], target offsets [1.5,-1.25], source angles 90/90, target angles 60/120, and the exact source-bound open/uncut/unfilled consumer profiles. Other angle/offset values, other combinations, flag or arity differences, cuts, closures, fills, other carriers or versions, native CAD rendering, complete document closure, and support claims remain unqualified.

controls.standaloneRegressionControls: The same focused selector retains the 90/90-to-60/120 angle-only profiles, refusals and retries. The offset-only retarget selector also passes.

focusedSelectors.summary: Both affected retarget projection selectors passed.

validation.observedAngleSelector: angle-only profiles=4; readbacks=8; refusals=2; late=2; retries=4; combined profiles=4; readbacks=8; refusals=2; late=2; retries=4
